summary: Ciprofloxacin carries a boxed warning in the United States for nerve and brain harm as well as muscle and bone problems [3]. A small computer model, rather than tests on people, gave it a high risk score for liver harm and a low risk score for heart harm [M]. An official warning notes it is not for injection into the eye and can cause severe, sometimes life-threatening allergic reactions that may include fainting, facial swelling, or tingling [7].
